body.heading: Where in the world is Slovakia?
paragraphs: Slovakia is a country in Eastern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Slovakia is Bratislava.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Slovakia is Slovak.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Slovakia is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Slovakia?
paragraphs: Slovakia covers about 49,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Iceland.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Slovakia's High Tatras are a compact wall of granite peaks, cable cars and mountain lakes — ride up Lomnický štít for a view over three countries.
Spiš is one of Europe's largest castle ruins, sprawling over a hill; the capital Bratislava charms with its old town, castle and Danube promenade.

body.heading: Think and talk

2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
